text: Provide the baseline batch of sixty consecutive seal-strength pull tests in build order.
Provide the programme charter, seal-strength specification, and committed product-margin requirement.
Provide the complete screening run in which three assembly settings were each run at low and high levels with two replicates, including run order, factor levels, and seal strength.
Provide the later composite response-surface design over bond angle and bead spacing, including all factor settings, coded or actual units, run responses, and the five centre runs.
Provide all twenty seal-strength results made at the settings recommended from the composite design, in build order, together with the implemented coded bond-angle and bead-spacing settings.
Provide the recommended settings confirmation seals batch: the twenty seal strength results.
What bond-angle and bead-spacing settings were actually recommended and used for the twenty confirmation seals, in coded and physical units if known, and was cure temperature held fixed?
